name: KICKICO
rootCause: KICKICO has experienced a security breach, which resulted in the attackers gaining access to the account of the KICK smart contract — tokens of the KICKICO platform. The team learned about this incident after the complaints of several victims, who did not find tokens worth 800 thousand dollars in their wallets. During the investigation, it was found that the total amount of stolen funds is 70,000,000 KICK, which at the current exchange rate is equivalent to $ 7.7 million.

descriptions.text: KICKICO has experienced a security breach, which resulted in the attackers gaining access to the account of the KICK smart contract — tokens of the KICKICO platform. The team learned about this incident after the complaints of several victims, who did not find tokens worth 800 thousand dollars in their wallets. During the investigation, it was found that the total amount of stolen funds is 70,000,000 KICK, which at the current exchange rate is equivalent to $ 7.7 million.

KICKICO suffered a major key compromise on Ethereum on 26 July 2018. Attackers used the stolen private key to destroy tokens at user addresses and recreate them at attacker-controlled addresses, affecting approximately 70 million KICK tokens valued around $7.7 million. The operator replaced the compromised key and committed to restoring user balances. No primary on-chain evidence or verified remediation record has been found. The single private key controlling the KICKICO token contract was compromised. This allowed attackers to burn tokens at legitimate user addresses and mint them in attacker-controlled wallets, with no secondary validation or multisig safeguard in place.

KICKICO posted details of a breach regarding their smart contract. An attacker managed to obtain the private key to the smart contract and used that to transfer $7.7M in funds into their possession. The hackers gained access to the private key of the owner of the KickCoin smart contract. In order to hide the results of their activities, they employed methods used by the KickCoin smart contract in integration with the Bancor network: hackers destroyed tokens at approximately 40 addresses and created tokens at the other 40 addresses in the corresponding amount.
